history.gap: The pull quote is merely large, not designed: a regular-weight serif at ~38px with a 40px stub rule above it and an italic "— de oprichter" is the stock editorial pattern, and on mobile it becomes nine centred lines with an ugly "snelle-rijk- / verhalen" break. At the bar the quote would be left-set on mobile with a hand-tuned rag (no hyphen breaks), the stat and quote would share one visible axis instead of the numeral hanging on its own column, and one element (an optical-size display cut, a hanging quote mark, or the gold leader actually meeting the numeral) would carry a signature so the section is recognisably this brand rather than "dark-gold trading template".
history.motion: Staggered fade-up of label/value rows, stat, then quote with a consistent cadence — restrained and legible, nothing broken but nothing memorable.
history.verdict: A is a disciplined, well-gridded stat-and-quote section whose only real sin is being predictable; B reaches for a far more distinctive atmosphere and photography but ships with clipped labels, struck-through nav, a mobile dead zone, and animation that eats spaces out of its own sentences. Ambition does not outrank execution here, so A takes it — neither is shortlist-ready as-is.
